text:
Noah: Quick follow-up to the KV-cache OOM retro. We need a minimal action list, owners, and short-term guards. I want weekly status until stable.

Rina: I can own the heap captures + diffs. Plan: pprof alloc/inuse on top 5 offenders, upload to s3 and paste links. ETA: 36h.

Harpreet: I will run a small GC parameter sweep in staging and a canary that reduces slab chunk size. Will record RSS/latency tradeoffs. ETA: 72h.

Noah: Concrete actions please so I can plug into the postmortem table.

Rina: Action 1 (Rina) - captures + dashboard for top alloc sites, include alloc_site and prefix tag. ETA: 36h.

Harpreet: Action 2 (Harpreet) - run canary (slab=64K, gc_interval=8s); collect CPU/RSS for 48h. ETA: 72h.

Noah: Action 3 (Noah) - short-term guard: per-shard memory cap at 85% with 2-restart quarantine. I will raise PR. ETA: 24h.

Rina: FYI small reproducer when eviction races with compaction; stack shows:
```
kvcache.evictPrefix
kvcache.compactWorker
runtime.mallocgc
```
I'll add a unit test that simulates concurrent eviction + compaction.

ci-bot: canary deployed: shard-canary-5 (slab=64K, gc_interval=8s) - build 2026.4.12-rc3

Harpreet: Adding metric last_full_sweep_seconds to correlate with RSS spikes.

alert-bot: new alert rule kv_cache_rss_change created - fires when delta(rss,1h)>0.14*mem for any shard.

Noah: Great. Who will own weekly check-ins? Need rotation.

Harpreet: I can handle the first two weeks. Will post minutes here.

Rina: Uploading first set of profiles now: s3://redwood-profiles/1969004567/rina-pprof-1.pb.gz

Noah: Thanks. Please keep PRs and test links updated in the postmortem doc so we can close items. :thumbsup:
